summary: Separate read-only recovery preparation from confirmed execution, protect against stale plans, define closed allowlisted operations, run recovery asynchronously, make concurrency atomic, and use deterministic bug deduplication.
required_fixes: Build and present the exact recovery plan before confirmation.
Store and revalidate a ticket-state fingerprint before execution.
Define strict parameters, preconditions, effects, and success criteria for every allowlisted operation.
Execute recovery as a background job with polling and observable stages.
Protect active recovery sessions with an atomic lock and guaranteed cleanup.
Generate deterministic structured bug signatures and search only the configured project repository.
Add security, stale-state, concurrency, polling, approval-gate, and deduplication tests.
